newsitem.title: USA: Mobil starts return of CA. alkylation unit.
newsitem.headline: Mobil starts return of CA. alkylation unit.

text.p: Mobil Corp on Monday said it began to restart its 22,000 barrel-per-day (bpd) alkylation unit at the Torrance, Calif. refinery, the final step in bringing the 130,000 bpd plant back from maintenance.
Maintenance work, begun in January, also brought the refinery's crude and coker units off line, according to trade sources familiar with the plant.
"A good portion of the plant was down," a company spokeswoman confirmed. "We're bringing the alkylation back up...I would expect by midweek we'll be fully operational," she said.
The refinery's crude unit restarted March 7, the company confirmed earlier.
